style.backgroundSystem: flat misty paper white #F7FAFA pages and pale water-blue #E3EFF4 pages for infographics, a seamless pale water-blue #E3EFF4 studio ground carrying a sculpted drift of fine white foam #FBFDFD for product shots, and natural honey-wood #B9814B board strips for still lifes, plus one deep ink-teal #1E3A42 closing field
style.direction: misty foam-terrain skincare commerce with honey-wood warmth

style.lightingSystem: soft cool top key about 5500K with a large diffused fill and a warm honey bounce off the wood side, micro-bubble surfaces lit to read as fine matte texture, soft grounded contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: consistent fresh foaming skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty paper white #F7FAFA, pale water-blue #E3EFF4, honey-wood brown #B9814B and deep ink-teal text #1E3A42, with citrus amber #E08A2E reserved for tiny highlight accents; a soft cool top key about 5500K balanced by a warm honey bounce so pale cool pages always meet warm wood; modern geometric sans-serif headlines each with one short uppercase letterspaced English kicker line; consistent hairline-framed label chips and round verdict seals; consistent concentric star-burst glyph icon style; dense micro-bubble foam rendered as a sculpted matte terrain together with natural honey-wood surfaces; the product kept at a stable scale, tilted or lying on the foam with a grounded contact shadow, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cartoon cloud shapes, no floating product without contact shadow.
noDrift: no floating product without contact shadow
style.presentationRules: the product keeps one stable scale, shown tilted or lying on the foam terrain instead of floating, always carrying a grounded contact shadow, its printed label rendered as soft low-contrast texture rather than sharp fabricated text, and every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: sculpted fine-bubble foam terrain #FBFDFD, natural honey-wood #B9814B board with visible grain, matte white foam-glazed ceramic dish #F4F6F6, plain glass-like ice cubes
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep ink-teal #1E3A42, each headline paired with one short uppercase letterspaced English kicker line and one thin hairline rule #1E3A42; citrus amber #E08A2E reserved for tiny highlight accents only
